import os, sys, json, gzip, base64, subprocess, shutil, time
os.environ["RFS_XDIRS"] = "/kaggle/input"   # FF path (CHANGES.md): root that rfs_train.py _xload would scan (unreachable in this stage: fvb_extract.py never calls load_extra); the runner rewrites this literal to the stage's own input view (original run: RFS_XDIRS unset -> the same /kaggle/input)
patches.effect_on_numbers: none (_xload is not reached by fvb_extract.py; when set, the root is the same datasets the run attached)
patches.why: defence in depth, parity with the RFS_XDIRS patch of WP-F (t163p_c5rl ...) and of t189_b2 / t163p_fvb: the decoded rfs_train.py _xload scans RFS_XDIRS or else the literal /kaggle/input, which the runner's text rewrite cannot reach; setting RFS_XDIRS in the stage text points it at the stage's own input view on every machine; run as is on Kaggle it is the original default

patches.old:
def find_all(name):
    return sorted(p for p in IN.rglob(name)) if IN.exists() else []
patches.new:
def find_all(name):
    return sorted(p for p in IN.rglob(name)) if IN.exists() else []
if not SMOKE and not find_all("train_English.txt") and find_all("train_set.zip"):   # FF path (CHANGES.md): FF_DATA keeps the organisers' train_set.zip packed (Kaggle served the dataset extracted); unpack train_set.zip only, next to itself; dev_set.zip is never opened
    import zipfile as _ff_zf
    _ff_tz = find_all("train_set.zip")
    assert len(_ff_tz) == 1, f"raw-v4: neither train_English.txt nor exactly one train_set.zip under {IN}: {_ff_tz}"
    with _ff_zf.ZipFile(_ff_tz[0]) as _ff_z:
        _ff_z.extractall(_ff_tz[0].parent)
    print("FF: unpacked", _ff_tz[0], "->", _ff_tz[0].parent / "train_set", "(dev_set.zip left packed)", flush=True)
patches.effect_on_numbers: none (same files as the extracted Kaggle view: members of the organisers' train_set.zip, sha256 1803739f... checked by raw_btc)
patches.why: the original run read ngnnguynchn/flag2027-raw-v4-p as Kaggle served it, extracted (train_set/train_set/train_English.txt next to faces/ and voices/). FF_DATA/00_raw/btc_mavceleb_v4/ keeps the organisers' files as delivered (train_set.zip, dev_set.zip, meta_file_train_set.csv) and the runner does not unzip raw data, so the os.walk for train_English.txt + faces/ found nothing and the cell stopped at 'thieu raw-v4'. When train_English.txt is absent (and not in smoke, where the walk is skipped), the block unpacks train_set.zip ONLY, beside itself inside the stage's own input view (real directories made by the runner; FF_DATA is not written), giving the Kaggle layout (train_set/train_set/, 4 levels below the input root, inside the walk's 7-level limit); dev_set.zip is excluded from the view and never opened. It does nothing when an extracted view is mounted (Kaggle). Same block as WP-F's t163b / t163l_orig patch (INTEGRATION_r2 B1).
